_note: Original advanced concept questions for trees.

questions.title: Root node
questions.prompt: What is the root of a tree?
questions.explanation: The root is the starting node at the top of the tree.

questions.title: Leaf node
questions.code:
Tree:
      A
     / \
    B   C

B and C have no children.
questions.explanation: A leaf is an endpoint in the tree, so it has no child nodes.

questions.title: Preorder trace
questions.code:
Root: A
Left child: B
Right child: C
Preorder visits node, then left, then right.
questions.prompt: What is the preorder visit order?
questions.explanation: Preorder visits the current node first, then left, then right.

questions.title: Inorder trace
questions.code:
Root: A
Left child: B
Right child: C
Inorder visits left, then node, then right.
questions.prompt: What is the inorder visit order?
questions.explanation: Inorder visits the left child, then the node, then the right child.

questions.title: Level order
questions.code:
Level order waiting queue:
front [A] back
then [B, C]
questions.prompt: Which structure is commonly used for level-order traversal?
questions.explanation: A queue keeps nodes in the order they were discovered, which gives level order.

questions.title: Tree height
questions.prompt: A height function gets heights from the left and right child. What should it return?
questions.explanation: Height follows the longest path down from the current node.

questions.title: Null child
questions.prompt: Why do tree functions usually check for a null/None node first?
choices: It is the base case for an empty subtree.
questions.explanation: A null/None node means there is no subtree to process. Checking it first gives recursive tree code a safe stopping point before it tries to read child links.

questions.title: Count tree nodes
questions.prompt: Arrange the recursive steps to count nodes in a binary tree.
lines: If the node is null/None, return 0.
Return 1 plus the left count plus the right count.
questions.explanation: The base case handles empty subtrees, and each real node contributes one to the total.
